techniques.transfer: Use native table layout for exact record/result comparisons instead of shrinking table diagrams inside SVG.

techniques.corrected_limitations: No dependency on pixels/DOM for scientific truth, no copied article values or clinical claims, no hover-only explanation, and no layout/framework migration.
